nom: TULA Wrinkle Treatment Drops Retinol Alternative Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the serum hydrates well and one describes it as the first winter without dry, flaky skin, though one dry/mature-skin user found it too oily under concealer.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say it is the rare retinol alternative that causes no redness, irritation, or breakouts, while others report burning, stinging, itching, or a severe allergic reaction requiring prednisone.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers find the formula moisturizing and silky but heavier, preferring it at night rather than under makeup in the morning.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (including women in their 50s, 60s and 80s) report visible reduction in fine lines and wrinkles and describe the product as gentle enough for daily long-term use.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines, softened forehead wrinkles, and firmer-looking skin within one to three weeks; a few longer-term users say lines were smoothed over a year, but several others saw no noticeable change after weeks of use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the serum as moisturizing, leaving skin soft, dewy or glowing without needing extra moisturizer; one review calls it drying and crusty during a severe negative reaction, but this is an outlier.
concerns.redness: Several sensitive-skin users state it causes no redness at all, but multiple other reviewers report their skin turned red, itchy, or burning, including one requiring medical treatment for an allergic reaction.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes peeling, crusty, dry patches lasting weeks after stopping use, indicating a damaged barrier, while most other reviewers report no such damage and note comfortable, non-irritating wear.
concerns.spots: A small number of reviewers mention reduced appearance of dark spots or more even skin tone with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts and some highlight it as blemish-free even for sensitive/acne-prone skin, but several others describe new breakouts, cystic acne flare-ups, or a purge period after starting.
concerns.oiliness: A number of reviewers note the formula leaves a greasy or oily residue, especially noticeable under makeup or concealer, while others specifically describe it as non-greasy and lightweight.

aspects.libelle: No fragrance or mild pleasant scent

extraits.texte: I've been using TULA since 2016 and absolutely love everything in the anti-aging line — EXCEPT THE RETINOL ALTERNATIVE DROPS. The Retinol Alternative actively destroyed my skin. When I say destroy, I mean, to the point where my face is still recovering, with peeling dry crusty patches, two weeks after discontinuing use. I do NOT have sensitive skin. I know that new products can take time to work, and since I trust Tula, I tried to give this product a solid month of use. From day one, back in December: The drops dried out my skin completely and made me breakout like I was going through puberty again, only with wrinkles. It also gave me really odd raised bumps all around my eyes and cheeks - and that's the one place on my face where I have never in my life had any issues. My forehead wrinkles got so much deeper that I scheduled Botox for a month earlier than I usually do. Use: I used the drops every other day for a month for the first week, to get my skin conditioned to the treatment. The second week, I used them daily. I couldn't last any longer. Even my husband was like "Woah, babe, did you get into something that's irritating your skin?" Since I started using Clinique skincare in my teens, 25 years ago, (it was pretty much the only option back then!) I've never had this happen with any other product from any other company. I currently use Dermalogica, Tula, OSea and SkinScript. This is the kind of thing I would want to know about if I was working in product develop

I really wanted to like this product but sadly I will be retuning it. I tried this product for about two months and my skin hated it. Im not new to retinol and I wanted something more natural since I have sensitive acne prone skin. First application I looked like a got a very bad sunburn. I was only using this twice a week. After the first initial burn my cystic acne flared up and caused a purge which I was okay with at first. Ive never had this reaction with past retinols. My skin stays pretty clear for the most part. This made my skin look horrible and I realized it was a reaction to something in the ingredients over purging. I have other tula products that I love but this is not for me. I think for the price abd amout of product you get, there are better options out there.

This product has worked wonders on my skin! I have been using for about a month, and I already see a difference! I have sensitive/acne prone combo skin. It leaves my skin super soft without breaking me out! It's expensive, but I truly works!

This is my favorite product ever. I have seen the most changes in my skin texture when using this product. I have sensitive skin and have not been able to use retinols before because of it. This alternative is perfect and gentle.

I'm on my third bottle of this serum. it is the only serum that doesn't leave my skin with that dreaded "tight" feeling, but instead hydrates my skin and leaves a beautiful glow. I use it every morning after I cleanse. Works seamlessly under moisturizer and sunblock. I highly recommend for mature, dry skin if you'd like radiant skin results.
I've been using this serum for about 3 years and absolutely love it! I have really dry skin and this feels wonderful.
This serum is amazing - it's the first winter where I haven't suffered from dry, flaky skin. I love that it feels moisturizing and not greasy. I can't go to sleep without it!
